releaseProbePolicy.measurementSubject: warm same-browser navigation start until all six external SVG image resources are loaded and decoded with non-zero intrinsic dimensions

limits: Iteration smoke plus one measurement-subject correction. The baseline proves the real pre-change strict-docs route; neither smoke nor cold-start observation is release evidence or a compositor/FPS claim.
